purpose: Test whether a derived Q4_K_M artifact improves the challenge-weighted throughput and memory trade-off without losing required safety or too much accuracy relative to the first-round Q8_0 survivor.

preflight.reason: Pinned llama-quantize disables requantization by default and warns that overriding this can severely reduce quality.
preflight.decision: Do not use --allow-requantize. Derive Q4_K_M once from the official BF16 source instead.

tool.conversion: convert_hf_to_gguf.py from the same pinned llama.cpp commit

conversion_environment.deviation: The pinned converter requirement requests torch 2.11.0, which has no Intel macOS wheel. PyTorch 2.2.2 was used only to read the verified safetensors and write BF16 GGUF; benchmark inference and quantization remain on the pinned llama.cpp commit.

derived.invalidation_reason: The converter wrote two byte-identical tensors even though config.json declares tied word embeddings. The profiler therefore counted 751632384 parameters rather than the official Q8 artifact's 596049920 and the file used more peak RSS despite being smaller on disk.

required_preconditions: raw byte length and SHA-256 match

sealed_set_policy: Do not evaluate either quantization on the sealed set until one final model artifact and prompt configuration are selected and frozen.
